facebook.label: Facebook
facebook.note: Recommendations were switched on for the Page on 2026-08-12; before that the Page returned nothing at all. The tab starts empty and fills as visitors leave recommendations. Facebook Recommendations are yes/no, so records carry `recommends` and leave `rating` null — never convert one into a star count.

analysis.note: Model is pinned to a dated snapshot so classification stays comparable month to month; the preflight catches the day it retires. gpt-4.1-mini is cheap and strong enough for fixed-vocabulary classification. gpt-5-mini is the upgrade if nuance disappoints. The key env var is OPENAI_KEY, matching the existing .env. Set provider to 'rules' to turn the model off deliberately, or 'ollama' with base_url http://localhost:11434/v1 to run locally in Actions.

reply_refresh.note: Owner replies are only visible by re-reading the review they sit on, and an incremental pull never revisits older reviews. Once a week the collector reaches back this far so replies posted to older reviews are picked up and the response queue actually clears. Costs one deeper Apify pull per week.

vocabulary.note: How the theme list grows. A subject visitors raise in min_reviews separate reviews spread over min_span_days becomes a real theme automatically. Every promotion re-labels the whole corpus so the new theme's history is real rather than starting at zero and faking a spike. Past reanalyse_max_reviews that re-label gets expensive, so the script reports instead of acting.

pullquotes.note: The public quote widget. Only 5-star reviews dated after opening are eligible. Every excerpt is verified as a verbatim substring of its review before it ships; anything that isn't is discarded and reported, never repaired.
